summary: M39b (Event Calendar + Birthday Reminders) and M39c (Scheme Season Activation Gate) tested end-to-end. Backend pytest: 20/20 passing (test_m39_events.py) covering Event CRUD RBAC (MPCA can C/U/D, Division 403 on all writes, Division can read), Birthday today/upcoming/mocked-email endpoints, Scheme activation GET/POST/reset with MPCA-only write RBAC, and the tournament + grant-claim POST gates that return 403 with 'not yet activated' on novel fiscal_cycle 2098-99, plus Member DOB persistence via PATCH /api/members/{id}. Frontend Playwright: MPCA persona sees /events with add-event-btn + birthdays-panel (Devendra Bundela · Turns 50), can open event-modal (fields: event-title/event-desc/event-date/event-location/event-type + save-event-btn), the created event immediately renders inside day-cell-2026-07-27 AND day-panel; Division Secretary sees same event read-only (add-event-btn absent, event content visible in day cell) and same birthday panel; /schemes shows activation-banner 'Schemes ACTIVATED · Season 2026-27' with download-schemes-pdf + upload-signed-pdf-btn + signed-pdf-input for MPCA, upload buttons hidden for Division; MemberDetail exposes data-testid='member-dob' with the ISO 1976-07-27 value; sidebar-collapse-btn is clickable and toggles both states without error. Bootstrap seasons 2024-25/2025-26/2026-27 confirmed active. Note: task spec referenced login testid 'sign-in-btn' but actual is 'login-submit-btn' — used the correct one.
action_items: (Doc-only nit) Task-spec referenced login testid 'sign-in-btn' but actual data-testid on Login.jsx L299 is 'login-submit-btn' — update task doc or add an alias.

(Optional) Event modal input testids are 'event-title'/'event-date'/'event-location'/'event-type' — spec mentioned '-input' suffix which does not exist. Consider standardising on the '-input' suffix pattern used elsewhere for consistency.

(Not tested by this run) Season switcher to 2027-28 showing NOT ACTIVATED banner + Division 'Awaiting MPCA' badge — testids 'season-switcher' and 'season-switcher-select' exist; unit-tested equivalent via GET /schemes/season-activation?fiscal_cycle=2099-99 → is_active=false which passed. Recommend a follow-up UI regression pass on the season-switcher flip once other visual polish lands.

(Not tested by this run) MPCA re-uploading a signed PDF via signed-pdf-input then verifying banner flips to 'signed by <persona>' — backend endpoint POST /schemes/season-activation was directly exercised in tests (test_mpca_can_activate). UI file-upload flow not automated.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/events.py::list_events accepts scope but ignores auth (comment says 'auth handled at frontend for now'). This is fine given the persona-chip model but means anyone with the public URL and any x-body-code header can read events. Add a small guard requiring at least persona headers to be present.

routes/events.py::birthdays_today/upcoming return the member's phone/email/photo_url without any auth. Since the app is persona-headers-only anyway this is consistent, but worth adding a scope check if this endpoint ever becomes internet-facing.

routes/events.py::update_event accepts a raw dict patch — good for flexibility but callers can send arbitrary fields (though they're intersected with `allowed`). Consider using an EventUpdate Pydantic model for stronger typing and OpenAPI docs.
routes/tournaments.py L163: gate on scheme activation happens BEFORE host/date validation (correct — fail-fast with clearest message). Good ordering.
routes/grant_claims.py L119-123: gate placed correctly at start of create_grant_claim. Consistent with tournaments.
